concept: S3 Lifecycle: transition to Standard-IA for infrequent access with ms retrieval
tests: Picking a storage class after 30 days of frequent access, when access becomes rare but must be millisecond-fast.
expected: Lifecycle transition to S3 Standard-IA after 30 days — cheaper storage, millisecond retrieval. Triggers: "frequently for 30 days, then rarely", "retrievable within milliseconds", "cost-effective".
why_not: Everything in Standard — more expensive; Glacier Deep Archive — hours to retrieve; One Zone-IA from day one — ignores the frequent access in the first 30 days and stores in a single AZ.
